title: Grateful Dead Live at Hilton Hotel on 1969-03-15

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of the Black & White Ball with a legendary Dark Star and solid supporting tunes, though the debut Hard to Handle is shaky.
ai_review.review: The recording (a sound‑board source) generally sounds clear and well‑mixed, especially on the Dark Star, St. Stephen → The Eleven → Turn On Your Lovelight sequence, but listeners note occasional EQ tweaks are needed and a few sections feel muddy. Musically the show shines with an inspired Dark Star and Pig Pen’s rare vocal/organ spot, while the first ever Hard to Handle is described as a mess, making the overall performance mixed‑but‑worthwhile.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical highlights and soundboard quality (average 4–5 stars), but a few note serious flaws; weighted average yields ~3.9.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is generally praised (5‑star mix, 4‑star recording) and clear, though some listeners recommend EQ adjustments; one reviewer calls it a "train wreck" indicating occasional muddiness or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial first set is missing several tunes, but the second half delivers a strong, flowing sequence of Dark Star into St. Stephen → The Eleven → Turn On Your Lovelight; overall pacing is praised despite the rough opening.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's tone described as alive and powerful (playing his Gibson SG), with a standout performance on Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pig Pen gets vocal and organ spotlight, noted as a highlight by reviewers.
